desc: Implement a non-empty segment tree monoid `(sum, max_prefix, max_suffix, max_subarray)` with a correct merge operation and invalid/empty handling.
Build occurrence lists for candidate values, preferably only negative values, and initialize the final answer with the maximum subarray sum of the original array.
For each candidate value, query and merge all non-empty gaps between consecutive occurrences using the segment tree, updating the answer only when the resulting array is non-empty.
Handle edge cases carefully: all elements equal, all-negative arrays, zero values, adjacent occurrences, empty gaps, and ensure an empty subarray is never counted as sum `0`.
Add and run sample tests plus additional edge-case/random brute-force tests; verify the implementation runs in `O(n log n)` time and `O(n)` memory.
